payload.text:
THE PORT AND THE REFERENCE DECLARE THE SAME JPEG RULES, HONOUR THEM FAITHFULLY, AND EMIT DIFFERENT BYTES -- SO THE DIVERGENCE IS THE ENCODER AND NOT THE POLICY. Measured 2026-09-10 in the first ref-versus-port compare, by snorkeltoast at the harness and independently by vc at the embedded data URIs. **Both sides are `JPEG_Q = 86` and both are Lanczos3, and both stamps say so.** The reference encodes through Pillow: `im.convert("RGB").save(dest, "JPEG", quality=JPEG_Q, optimize=True, progressive=True)` (`showreel:321-322`). The port encodes through `image`: `JpegEncoder::new_with_quality(&mut bytes, JPEG_Q)` (`normalise.rs:228`) -- **baseline, default Huffman tables, no optimize pass, no progressive scan.**
THE COST IS MEASURED AT THE BYTES, NOT INFERRED FROM THE RMSE. vc decoded the data URIs from both payloads. Six artwork slides, reference against port: 244,673/280,175 (+14.5%), 220,801/262,088 (+18.7%), 320,002/413,193 (+29.1%), 212,267/265,133 (+24.9%), 288,468/375,373 (+30.1%), 373,154/475,201 (+27.3%). **+411,798 bytes across those six**, against a whole-artifact delta of **5,462,781 vs 4,817,189, +645,592, +13.4%** -- so the artwork accounts for roughly two thirds of it. **GEOMETRY AGREES ON EVERY ONE**, w and h identical in both signatures including slide 7's 1396 after the `round_ties_even` fix, so this is not a sizing difference and not the rounding class.
AND IT IS THE SIX SLIDES THE COMPARE FAILED ON. 6 of 19 graded slides over floor -- RMSE 0.974848, 0.890194, 2.912948, 0.929782, 2.617573, 2.520966, every one an artist artwork JPEG. Slides 12-22 read 0.000000 and slide 13 reads 0.001500. **The three exempt slides are the hand-placed brand and location assets, and nothing outside the six is over floor.**
NEITHER ENCODER IS WRONG AND THIS IS A DIVERGENCE RATHER THAN A DEFECT OR A REFUSAL -- snorkeltoast's framing and vc agrees. A baseline JPEG at quality 86 is a correct JPEG at quality 86.
THE DECISION IS hv'S BECAUSE IT IS A BUDGET QUESTION, AND THE MEASUREMENT THAT MAKES IT BINARY IS ON THE RECORD: **`image` 0.25's `JpegEncoder` exposes exactly TWO constructors, `new` and `new_with_quality`.** There is no progressive option and no optimize option. **So matching the reference cannot be done inside the approved manifest** -- it needs a new encoder crate, which is a manifest change, which needs hv's sign-off named in the commit under AC-3.9 and turns AC-3.14's gate red until the approved list is amended in the same commit.
vc'S RECOMMENDATION, WITH ITS LIMIT STATED: **accept the divergence and do not spend the budget.** The RMSE figures are 0.89 to 2.91 on a 0-255 scale, which is small -- **and vc has NOT measured whether that is perceptible, so the recommendation rests on byte cost rather than on a claim about what anyone can see.** The artifact's design premise is self-containment from a USB stick, which 5.2 MB satisfies as well as 4.6 MB does. **THE OTHER WAY IS ALSO SOUND** and would buy back roughly 645 KB and bit-closer parity; it costs a third-party crate in a budget hv has guarded twice.
WHAT MUST HAPPEN EITHER WAY, AND IT IS NOT OPTIONAL: **this divergence is recorded as EXPECTED in snorkeltoast's `PORT_EXPECTATIONS` before the next compare**, or every future run re-reports six slides as a failure that has already been adjudicated. That is what the mechanism is for.
AND THE FLOORS THEMSELVES NEED CORRECTING REGARDLESS OF THE RULING -- snorkeltoast's own finding against their own instrument. The per-slide floors derive from a control measuring **the REFERENCE'S STABILITY**, one artifact rendered repeatedly, which is why they read 0.000000. **Stability and cross-implementation agreement are different quantities, and a zero floor demands bit-exactness no cross-language port can deliver on JPEG.** The FAIL survives the correction -- all six also exceed the declared noise floor `min_defect` 0.223607 -- but the derivation conflates two things and the conflation is snorkeltoast's to fix, not cc's.
hv RULED 2026-09-10 19:4xZ: **ACCEPT THE DIVERGENCE.** No encoder crate, no manifest change, and the port keeps `JpegEncoder::new_with_quality`. The +645,592 bytes are accepted as the price of staying inside the approved budget, and `image` remains the only image dependency. **AC-3.14's gate is untouched and the approved nine stand.**
SO WHAT REMAINS ON THIS ROW IS THE FOLLOW-THROUGH, WHICH THE ROW ALREADY CALLED NOT-OPTIONAL: **the divergence is recorded as EXPECTED in snorkeltoast's `PORT_EXPECTATIONS` before the next compare runs.** Until it is, every future run re-reports six adjudicated slides as a failure and the FAIL means nothing because it means the same thing whatever changes. **THIS ROW DOES NOT SATISFY ON THE RULING.** A decision is not a mechanism; the row satisfies when vc has read the expectation entry in snorkeltoast's tree and confirmed it names the six slides, the cause, and the byte cost -- not when hv says yes and not when snorkeltoast says it is done.
AND THE RULING IS RECORDED WITH THE LIMIT vc GAVE IT RATHER THAN AS AN ENDORSEMENT: vc recommended accepting on BYTE COST, having explicitly NOT measured whether RMSE 0.89 to 2.91 on a 0-255 scale is perceptible. **hv ruled on that recommendation as stated.** If anyone later finds the divergence visible, this row was decided without that evidence and says so, which is the difference between a decision that can be revisited and one that looks settled.
